details.detail: Door-3 self-service bar (m05, m06, m17, q11) vs ANA's render (samchui_11). The round-2 note is fixed: the fridge now shows clear bottles with blue labels, not saturated blue blocks. Proportions, the 7 ash doors, the steel nosing, the black upper unit with its blind, monitor, bottle shelf and fridge, and the black canopy with 3 downlights and lit edge bands all match. Still missing: the low steel/glass guard rail along the back and ends of the counter in samchui_11. Still checked against the render only.

Door-2 welcome galley (m03, m16, m18) vs omaat_Room-32, lalf_134 and sp_09. The brewer now sits inside its bay. The dark soffit with downlights runs across the whole cross-aisle to both door surrounds (m16, m18), which fixes the round-2 issue. The monitor, control panel, ovens, glass cabinet, charcoal ends and aluminium nosing are right.

Door-2 aft monuments (m04, m13, rb3/k7). The 7K galley now has a clean ash lower body: no white frame or strip shows, so the coincident-body z-fight is gone. The R2 jump seat is on the galley's white end post beside the door. The ash centre wall with its framed flaps and the narrowed 7A closet with its jump seat are unchanged and good. The tied J curtains sit flush against the monument edges.

Door 1, F front wall and flight-deck door (q01, m01, m02, rb3/d1aisle). The front wall is now continuous at z 7.40, and the ink clouds are finally visible: luminance std/mean on the wall is 0.093 in m02 against 0.092 in tpg_147. The door-1 galleys have the map's depths and are capped to the ceiling. The weak point is the F front curtains. Each aisle opening (0.80 m) holds two untied panels about 0.36 m wide at xg = edge ± 0.18, which leaves a 0.08 m slit. The boarding view (q01) is two beige-grey slabs closing the aisle. In tpa_IMG_0220 and ffF they are narrow gathered bundles with most of the opening clear, and much darker (0.36-0.39 of wall luminance, against 0.55-0.58 in m02 and q01).

Lavatory exteriors. The J lavs follow OMAAT 32 (ash, white seam and grab), the F lav is ebony, and the Y/PY lavs and the wheelchair lav are white with a pull and an occupancy plate. Door-3 depth is still 1.05 m. On the ANA map the door-3 baby-change lavs are 93 px deep, about 1.86 m at 50 px/m (J pair of 107 in = 136 px). The door-2 lavs on the same map are 55 px (1.1 m).

F/J bulkhead, J face (m07, m14, m15). The cream wall, the seam, the blue-topped wall boxes under the bins and the tied charcoal curtain against the panel edge all match. The curtain renders #615953 against #5e5655 in tpg_71, so it is fixed.

J/PY bulkhead, PY face (m08). The panels were rebuilt per alv_IMG_7207/7209 and now match: flat charcoal-framed monitors (2 outboard, 4 centre), grey floor pouches and the sticker. The curtain is wrong. alv_IMG_7209 shows it TIED back at about 1.3 m in dark warm charcoal (#38312b lit, #1f1c1d in the folds), narrow against the outboard panel edge. The model uses an untied navy panel about 0.36 m wide (#363c59), which fills about 2/3 of the aisle gap in m08.

Door-4 group (m09, m10, q13, rb3/d4L, d4R). The wheelchair lav, centre galley, right galley, row-30 monitors and PY aft curtains follow the map and py_37302. There are still no attendant seats at L4 or R4 (d4L and d4R show bare lav and galley ends beside both doors). The PY aft curtains are the right untied form, but read as solid columns (see curtains).

Rear, door 5 (m11, m12, q19, rb3/d5fwd). The blank end of the work aisle is fixed: it now has six standard containers over a counter and a lower door (m12). From the work aisle looking forward, the centre closet and the baby-change lav sit left and right of centre as on the map (d5fwd). Jump seats are on the galley fore ends. The map shows two jump seats on the left galley and one on the right; the model has one on each. The rear curtain is a light-grey column 0.36 m wide.

Standard galley inserts (m01, m09, m12, d4L, d4R). The upper stowage doors now have inset panels, labels and paddles, and the G/OVEN/CHILLER placard is present. With the ovens, brewers, carts with cards and the lit work strip under the upper units, these read as real galleys. They are still slightly clinical: every galley is identical.

Curtains overall. Colours for F/J and J are right, and the tied J bundles (m04, m07, m13, m15) are good. Problems: (1) the F front panels close both F aisles to a slit. (2) The J/PY curtain should be a tied charcoal bundle, not a navy panel. (3) The untied panel is a closed oval tube 0.36 × 0.2 m with shallow ±16 % pleats, so in m09, m10 and m11 it reads as a solid column, not a pleated drape. (4) Its top ring is ragged and stands proud of the 0.035 m rail (m09, m10).

Jump seats. There are now 8: L1, R1, both at door 2, both at door 3 beside the narrowed lav doors (m17), and 2 at door 5. They are grey on grey pedestals and placed on free walls. Doors 4L/4R still have none.

issues.detail: F front curtains close both F aisles (boarding view q01)
issues.problem: addCurtain with tied=false uses _curtainPanel, which is 2 × 0.10 × 1.55 × (1 + 0.16) ≈ 0.36 m wide at the hem. Line 836 places two per 0.80 m opening at xg = a + 0.18 and b - 0.18, so the clear gap is about 0.08 m. q01 and d1aisle show two beige-grey slabs filling the aisle. The panels are also too light: curtain/wall luminance is 0.55-0.58 against 0.36-0.39 in the photos.

issues.fix: Line 836: make the F front curtains narrow gathered bundles. Either pass tone 'F' with tied=true (change line 554 to tied when m.tone === 'C' || m.tone === 'F'), or add a slim panel loft with widths about 0.55 × the current ones (s ≈ 0.85 instead of 1.5). Place them at xg = a + 0.09 and b - 0.09, leaving ≥ 0.55 m clear. Darken MONMAT.curtainF from '#6e665f' to about '#4f4843'.

issues.detail: J/PY curtain: wrong form and colour
issues.problem: The loop at lines 705-712 gives J/PY (F=false) an untied panel in MONMAT.curtainY navy, placed at a.x1 + 0.18. Its comment cites alv_IMG_7207/7209, but 7209 clearly shows a TIED curtain: tieback at about 1.3 m, narrow below it, fanning to the track, warm charcoal. It is not navy. The navy is only the PY aft-end curtain (py_37302 #3e4051).
issues.evidence: alv_IMG_7209 curtain #38312b (lit) / #1f1c1d (folds); alv_IMG_7207 #3b3a3b. m08 renders #363c59 and fills about 2/3 of the gap.
issues.fix: Line 711: addCurtain(B, a.x1, b.x0, zc, right ? b.x0 - 0.14 : a.x1 + 0.14, F ? MONMAT.curtainF : MONMAT.curtainC, true). This makes both bulkhead curtains tied, with J/PY in the J charcoal. Keep curtainY for the door-4 PY aft pair only.

issues.detail: Untied panel curtains read as solid columns, with a ragged top
issues.problem: _curtainPanel = curtainLoft([[0.02,1.55,1.3],[1.0,1.5,1.25],[2.17,1.45,1.2]]) is a closed oval tube about 0.33 × 0.17 m. The pleat term r = 1 + 0.16·sin(11a) gives only shallow bumps, so in m09, m10 and m11 the PY and rear curtains are flat-shaded posts. The top ring's lobes stick out past the 0.035 m-deep rail, giving a wavy, torn-looking top edge.
issues.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/def7adec-914e-5e60-a393-36ec08abe9d9/scratchpad/r4/m09_d4fwd.png, /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/def7adec-914e-5e60-a393-36ec08abe9d9/scratchpad/r4/m10_d4aft.png (navy column, lumpy top), /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/def7adec-914e-5e60-a393-36ec08abe9d9/scratchpad/r4/m11_rearL.png (grey pillar); py_37302 shows deep vertical pleats about 0.4 m wide, hung flat along the track.
issues.fix: Add a panel-specific loft: depth scale about 0.35 (≈ 0.05 m thick), pleat amplitude 0.35 with 16 lobes, width scale 1.2 (≈ 0.26 m). Set the top level at CURTAIN_H - 0.03 with s = 1.0 so it tucks under the rail, and widen the rail gBox depth to 0.05.

issues.problem: L.jumps (line 884) covers doors 1, 2, 3 and 5 only. Every Type A exit has an adjacent attendant seat. In d4L and d4R the wheelchair-lav end and the right galley end beside the doors are bare.
issues.fix: Append [-2.30, dz[3][0], 1] (the wheelchair lav's aft face outboard of its door; narrow the door with jumpX = -2.30 if they overlap) and [2.40, dz[3][0], 1]. Also set jumpX: 2.40 on the right galley at line 866 so onCounter does not filter it out.

issues.detail: Door-3 monuments still 1.05 m deep (3rd round)
issues.problem: MONO_LAYOUT.d3 = 1.05. On the official map the door-3 baby-change lavs are 93 px deep, about 1.86 m, against 1.1 m for the door-2 lavs. The bar block with its angled side walls reaches the same line.
issues.evidence: ana_seatmap_73E.png crop y 995-1088 (door-3 lavs) vs J rows 17-19 = 136 px per 107 in pair
issues.fix: Raise MONO_LAYOUT.d3 to about 1.45 (a compromise, since the map is schematic). Recheck that pyLeg 0.92 and the door-4 centre galley (pz27 + 0.32 .. dz[3][0]) keep at least 0.55 m. If they do not, ask the user (see questions).
